title: Without the Settings - Parts permission the Categories page does not open
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA04 User) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • The role of {User-B}, {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA04 Role), does not have the Settings - Parts permission.
  • The web address of the Categories page, {Address-A} (for example the app address followed by /administration/categories), was copied beforehand while signed in as an Admin.
custom_steps:
1. Paste {Address-A} into the browser's address bar.
  2. Press Enter.
  3. Look at the page that is shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the Categories page does not open. You never see the Categories list.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-N3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Categories - after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
